speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever following recent antibiotic treatment for acute sinusitis. To better understand your condition, can you tell me when these new symptoms started and if you have noticed any changes in your urination, such as frequency, urgency, or blood?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis. Given your history of recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis followed by persistent fever, fatigue, and flank pain, this strongly suggests an ascending urinary tract infection. Have you noticed any nausea, vomiting, or chills, and do you have any history of kidney stones or recent urinary procedures? REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine_Culture.
